stem.text: Three parallel metal plates of the same area are fixed with a separation of $2.0\,\text{cm}$ between the top plate and the middle plate, and $1.0\,\text{cm}$ between the middle plate and the bottom plate. The top plate is held at a potential of $+500\,\text{V}$, the middle plate at $+200\,\text{V}$ and the bottom plate is earthed, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of three parallel plates with points X and Y between them; separations of 2.0 cm and 1.0 cm are marked; the top plate is labelled +500 V, the middle plate +200 V and the bottom plate 0 V, with an earth symbol.

stem.text: What is the value of the ratio $\dfrac{\text{magnitude of force on an electron at X}}{\text{magnitude of force on an electron at Y}}$?
